subject: geography
title: Oceans, currents, and global connections
objective: Explain the role of oceans and currents in a connected world.

lesson.opening: Oceans cover most of the planet, move heat around it, and carry most of its trade.

sections.heading: The oceans
sections.body: Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, and Arctic. The Pacific is the largest and deepest.

sections.heading: Currents and climate
sections.body: Surface currents move warm water toward the poles and cold water toward the equator, moderating climate. The Gulf Stream warms western Europe.

sections.heading: Global connections
sections.body: Ships carry the bulk of world trade, and undersea cables carry the data. Oceans link economies as much as they separate coasts.
